# CBDB-Desktop: Kinship (Look At Kinship) label revisions, 2026-10-28

Sixth form in the review of HTML labels against the MS Access FormLabels table (form code LAK, 33 rows in the updated 643-row table). Changes are in the Kinship form's index.html only; no back-end change was needed. The page script was syntax-checked, and the page was loaded in a scripted browser (jsdom) with a stand-in server to check every label in all three languages, the language switch, a query, Store Person IDs and the Mourning Circle checkbox, with no script errors. **Not yet tested in the running app**; spacing and fit are still to be checked. A copy of the file before these changes was kept as index.before-labels.html. Revised later the same day with the user's answers to five questions (the last: "Look At …" in the title): the page-title pattern (LBL-68), a Display Language label (LBL-78), the language buttons (LBL-79) and the Access-only options LAK 32–33.

## How to revert a label

This form kept its labels differently from the others. They were in a LABELS object keyed by **number** (data-lbl-idx="27" on the element), and the numbers followed the VBA's changeDisplayLanguage routine. They matched the LAK row numbers only in part: index 10 was Save to KML where LAK 10 is Exit, 16 was Person count where LAK 16 is Big5, 29 was Mourning Circle where LAK 29 is Delete 0-degree nodes, and so on. To stop those numbers being read as LAK rows, the labels now have **named keys** (data-lbl="storeIDs"), like the T objects on the other forms (KIN-2).

All labels are in LABELS near the top of the script, with E, T and S (English, traditional, simplified) for each key. To go back to the earlier wording, change the value in the language concerned. Each entry has a comment naming its FormLabels row, its old index, and, where changed, the earlier wording. The English is also written in each HTML element; changeDisplayLanguage overwrites it on load. The ▶ on Run Query and the ← on Navigation are added by a data-lbl-prefix attribute, so the keys hold only the words, as on Entry.

## Notes

**LBL-68.** The title bar and the browser tab title now follow the language. The title text was wrapped in &lt;span id="page-title"&gt;, and changeDisplayLanguage also sets document.title. The title follows the pattern most forms use, "CBDB: " + form name, with the form name as "Look At …" (both the user's decisions, 2026-10-28; Chinese scholars also call the database CBDB). The HTML had "Looking at Kinship". The Chinese 查看親屬關係 uses 查看 as LAN 60 and the other forms, and 親屬關係 as the Browser's Kinship tab (BIO 49). The colon after CBDB is an ASCII colon followed by a space in all three languages, since it follows a Latin name.

**LBL-69.** As on Associations and Browser (LBL-60, LBL-67): the link got id="lnkNavigation" and a navigation key. LAK 10 (Exit 退出) was not used, as on the other forms.

**LBL-70.** The Person Selection heading had no key and stayed in English. 人物選擇 / 人物选择 is new wording (no row); 選擇人名 was not reused because it is the Select Person button just below. The Person count colon is now full-width in Chinese, as with Display Language on the other forms. LAK 16 (Big5) is not this label, although the old index was 16.

**LBL-71.** Recall Person IDs now matches the table and the other forms (CBDB-D-007). The old 調出ID / 调出ID was the alternative the Group Data report had considered and set aside.

**LBL-72.** LAK 4–7 give the Access labels for these four inputs. The Chinese 先世值≤ etc. is the table's, with ≤ in place of a colon, and matches the step columns already decided for the Browser and Networks (SF_KIN 8–11, LAN 66–69). The table's English abbreviations "Max Ancestor Gen." and "Max Descend Gen." were written out, as with "Use Person Addr" on Entry, and the colon before the input was kept. The English labels are now much longer than "Max Up:". **Check that they fit `lbl-wide`.** If they don't, "Max Ancestor Gen.:" and "Max Descend Gen.:" are the table's own short forms.

**LBL-73.** Mourning Circle is 五服 in LAK 3; the HTML had 服制圈. 五服 is the usual term for the five grades of mourning dress and the kin they cover. The English already matched.

**LBL-78.** The form had no label before its language buttons. A &lt;span id="lbl-display-language"&gt; with a displayLanguage key now sits in the title bar before them, with LAK 25's wording and, in Chinese, the full-width colon used on the other forms (顯示語言： / 显示语言：).

**LBL-79.** The buttons now read EN / 繁 / 简, as on the other forms (user's decision, 2026-10-28). They are fixed text, the same in every language, so the langTrad and langSimp keys were removed. Before, the traditional and simplified buttons changed with the language (繁體 / 繁体, 簡體 / 简体).

**LBL-74, LBL-75.** As on every other form: 查詢 / 查询 with ▶ kept; Store Person IDs 儲存人物代碼 / 存储人物代码 under the regional-usage rule (LAK 27 has 存儲 in c_fanti). The old simplified 储存人物ID mixed traditional and simplified (储 simplified, 存 shared, but the mainland term is 存储).

**LBL-76.** All the export buttons said 存至… ("store to"), which no other form uses. They now say 保存于…, as in LAK 11, 12, 17, 18 and 30, with 于 in both modes. "Export Neo4j" becomes "Save to Neo4j" (LAK 30), matching the other forms. Save to KML has no row; it follows the same pattern. Save to GIS here sends format: 'tab'; the label was not changed to say so.

**LBL-77.** The tabs take LAK 22, 23 and 31, as Group Data took LAG 21–25. "Ego-Relative Kinship Network" / 被檢索者相關的親屬網絡 ("kin network relative to the person queried") is long. **Check that the tab bar doesn't wrap**, particularly in Chinese (11 characters). The People tab becomes 親屬網絡的人 ("people in the kinship network"), the same pattern as LAA 11 社會關係的人 and LAT 10.

## KIN-1: "IDs saved to store" was shown all the time

**Symptom.** The note "IDs saved to store" (ID已儲存) sat permanently under the export buttons, from the moment the page opened, whether or not anything had been stored.

**Cause.** The &lt;span&gt; (class clipboard-label) took index 24 from the VBA, where LAK 24 is the Access datasheet's clipboard instruction ("To save the data to the Clipboard, click on the square in the upper left corner…"). The HTML version gave index 24 the store message instead, but nothing ever showed or hid the span.

**Fix.** The span now has id="lbl-ids-stored", starts hidden, is shown when Store Person IDs succeeds (including after confirming a replacement), and is hidden again when the next query starts, since those results have not been stored. A helper, setIdsStoredVisible(visible), does this. The wording is now "Person IDs stored" / 已儲存人物代碼 / 已存储人物代码, in line with Store Person IDs. The status bar still says "Stored N person ID(s)." as before.

**jsdom check.** On load: hidden. After a query: hidden, Store enabled. After Store: shown. After a second query: hidden.

## KIN-2: Housekeeping

- **Named keys** replace the numeric indices (see "How to revert a label"). If cbdb_styles.css refers to [data-lbl-idx], it needs changing to [data-lbl]; I couldn't check the stylesheet.
- **English in the markup.** Every labelled element now has its English text in the HTML, so the page is readable before the script runs.
- **Labels linked to inputs.** &lt;label for&gt; was added to the four step-limit labels, so clicking a label focuses its box. They precede their inputs, so the global checkbox rule doesn't grey them; a new rule in cbdb_styles.css (CSS-2, see the Office report of 2026-10-28) now greys the label of any disabled number box, so they grey when Mourning Circle disables the boxes.
- **Unused entries removed.** LABELS held seven entries with no element on the page, copied from the VBA: 3 Mourning: 服制:, 4 Max Ancestor: 最長祖先:, 15 GB18030, 17 Save to Gephi 保存於Gephi, 18 Save GIS 存至GIS, 25 Display: 顯示:, 26 Help 幫助, plus a commented-out 19. They were removed so they can't be mistaken for live labels.
- Comments that called the first tab "Ego-Relative Relationships" now use the tab's name.

## Issues

1. **Untranslated text.** The placeholders ((name), (名), (ID)), "[Imported List]" and "[Recalled List]", "No results yet. Run a query to begin.", "N ego-relationship record(s) found.", the status, error and confirmation messages, and the sort tooltips are English only.
1. **Results-table headers.** Hard-coded and mixed, as on the other query forms (KinName / 親戚姓名, KinRel, Up, Down …). If translated later, SF_KIN 3–4 and 8–11 (親屬關係類別, 親戚姓名, 先世值 …) are the obvious sources.
1. **Neo4j and Export Query Results status.** Both messages say the files were "compressed to ZIP file" while the code downloads each file separately. Check which is true.
